name: Quote generation - name provided in different phrasing
description: Customer introduces themselves with a different phrasing ('This is John, quote me for...'). AI should extract the name and use generate_quote.

messages.text: This is John, quote me for 8 sheets of white melamine 16mm please

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a quote total with R prefix
Quote should be generated (quote_total populated or PDF URL in reply)
Quote generation may take up to 30 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
No internal optimizer variable names in reply

notes: Tests name extraction with a different phrasing ('This is John'). Verifies the AI handles varied introductions.
